provenance.derived_from: decompilation only; no emulator, bridge or native run

functions.note: read and getReadBuffSize each materialize their own triple of strings, so both are named by the binary independently.

container_primitive.comment: Identical to ObjBin.json and OrderBin.json; repeated so this file stands alone.

node.name: data_off
node.note: 0 means absent; resolved as node + data_off

node.name: table_off
node.note: 0 means absent; resolved as node + table_off

record.size_evidence: SetBin::read 0x8232F5F8 allocates count * 0x08 and zeroes puVar6[0..1] before each ActBin::read call

fields.name: data
fields.note: carries the u8 order count at its first byte

fields.name: orders
fields.note: points at an array of `count` OrderBin records of 0x2C each; written only when count != 0

record.note: ActBin is a pure list header. It owns no variant and no scalar of its own beyond the count byte.

count.location: first byte of the resolved data word

list.early_exit: count == 0 returns before the child table is read or the orders pointer is written
list.per_element_fail_closed: 0x82010218 'ActBin::read() / order empty! : %d', raised when the index reaches the table count or the child node is empty

buffer_accounting.read: reserves count * 0x2C, then advances by OrderBin::getReadBuffSize per element
buffer_accounting.getReadBuffSize: returns 0 when count == 0, otherwise count * 0x2C plus the sum of OrderBin::getReadBuffSize over the elements
buffer_accounting.cross_check: getReadBuffSize zeroes eleven u32 of stack scratch per element, the same 0x2C OrderBin record read allocates

SetBin.count: u8 at the resolved data word
SetBin.note: SetBin has the same 0x08 list-header shape as ActBin, one level up.

arithmetic_cross_checks.sum_orders_per_act_equals_orderbin_recor: 2975, the exact count the independently written OrderBin validator reports

notes: No SetBin or ActBin declares more elements than its child table holds, so the `act empty! : %d` and `order empty! : %d` paths never fire on this payload.
No Act declares zero orders, so the early exit in read() is never taken here.
Acts per Set are 1 to 4; orders per Act reach 52.

not_established: the meaning of the bytes after the count in the resolved data word
what an Act groups semantically; only that it is an ordered list of Orders
